Metadata.description: Portfolio of Adriane Almeida Gonçalves: React, React Native, TypeScript, and REST APIs. Santarém, Portugal.

Home.roleTitle: Frontend Developer · Software Engineer · Full Stack Developer
Home.heroBio: Over 2 years of hands-on frontend experience with React, React Native, and TypeScript—on client projects and university research. I integrate authenticated REST APIs, build reusable modules, and work in Agile teams with Git and Azure DevOps.

About.headline: About Me
About.imageAlt: Illustration of a seated cat in a purple vector style
About.title: Frontend Developer · Software Engineer · Full Stack Developer
About.intro: Developer with 2+ years of practical frontend experience using React, React Native, and TypeScript on client and research projects. Experienced integrating authenticated REST APIs, shipping reusable modules, and delivering in Agile teams with Git and Azure DevOps. BSc in Computer Engineering at Polytechnic University of Santarém (expected 2027). Full Stack Web Bootcamp at Labenu (2023).

Projects.subtitle: Projects
Projects.title: Featured Work
Projects.description: Academic and professional projects from my CV—mobile, computer vision, and this portfolio site.

project4.title: Full-stack portfolio
project4.description: Personal site built with Next.js 16, i18n, dark/light theme, and a contact form with Zod validation and email delivery via Node.js Server Actions and Resend.

project1.title: SerPlena — Women's Well-being
project1.description: Client React Native app for daily tracking of physical and emotional well-being, with charts of the most logged emotions over time (Teamsoft).

project2.title: Facial Expression Recognition (CNN)
project2.description: Academic project (UPS, 2026): computer vision pipeline with FER-2013 and a Python CNN (TensorFlow/Keras) for 7 emotions—62% overall accuracy; best on happy (83% precision, F1 0.84).

project3.title: Virtual Showroom — Industrial Stock
project3.description: React Native screens for industrial stock digitization with a virtual showroom (Android and iOS), Figma prototypes, and design-to-code handoff (UPS research grant, 2025).

Experience.subtitle: Experience
Experience.title: Professional Experience
Experience.description: React, React Native, and TypeScript delivery with REST API integration in Agile teams.

item1.description: Built React Native screens for a cross-platform mobile app digitizing industrial stock, including a virtual showroom. Designed Figma prototypes and implemented screens, bridging design and code.

item2.description: Reusable React/TypeScript reporting module (MRO project) with dynamic filters and authenticated REST APIs. Full SerPlena app in React Native. New screens and fixes on an e-commerce-style audiovisual stock system. Legacy maintenance on Angular 7.

item3.description: Frontend components in JavaScript, HTML, and CSS. Participated in Agile ceremonies and team release cycles.
